reason: The README describes a DSH Web plugin that augments tool-approval interactions by collecting rejection comments, steering the current agent turn, and controlling whether execution stops or continues.

summaries.zh: 这是一个增强 DSH Web 工具审批流程的插件，支持附加拒绝说明，并根据用户决定中止或继续当前智能体回合。
summaries.en: A DSH Web plugin that enhances tool approval with rejection comments and lets users stop or continue the current agent turn based on their decision.

capabilities: Captures user comments on approval decisions
Injects comments into the current agent turn
Terminates or continues agent turns based on approval input
Provides a one-time grant for a subsequent tool call
